text: AGREEMENT
THIS AGREEMENT is made as of the 15th day of December, 1991,
by and between Philip Morris Incorporated, a Virginia corporation
with executive offices located at 120 Park Avenue, New York, New
York, 1oo17 ("Philip Morris") and Tamera Herrod Public Relations
with offices located at 10190 Boca Entrada Boulevard, Room 232,
Boca Raton, Florida 33428 ("THPR").
Services
THPR will perform publicity and public relations
services, which will include the following, in connection with the
Virginia slims of Florida event (the "Tournament") of the 1992
Kraft General Foods World Tour (the "Tour") to be held March 2nd
through 8th, 1992 at the Polo Club in Boca Raton, Florida. THPR
will:
(a) Provide the personal services of Tamera Herrod,
which are the essence of the Agreement;
(b) Prepare a public relations plan, including pre and
post-Tournament plans for the Tournament and a detailed
description of the type and amount of anticipated
expenses for the advance approval of Philip Morris. The
public relations plan must be submitted to Philip Morris
upon the execution of the Agreement;
(c) Assist in developing, organizing, and selecting
sites for scheduled press conferences and other press
events in the Tournament market and provide logistical
support on-site;
(d) Perform
npre-Tournamentpublicity,i
including
researching and coordinating media lists, adapting and
writing local press releases, writing media alerts,
developing photo opportunities, developing innovative
story angles and conducting a player media day;
(e) Attend
all
organizational
meetings
for the
Tournament;
(f) Provide year round publicity services in connection
with the Tournament and Virginia Slims Tennis if and when
requested by Philip Morris;
(g) Set up the press room and ensure that telephones and
fax and photocopying machines are operational on or
before February 29, 1992.
Operate the press room
